title: St. Ivory | KEY.co
description_expanded: St. Ivory is a stunning custom-designed tower home in Rosemary Beach, offering a rare and spacious private lot designed for relaxation and connection. This luxurious five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bath retreat features an open floor plan that brings family and friends together with effortless style. French doors open from the main living area to a beautiful courtyard oasis complete with a private heated pool, outdoor living room with fireplace, and built-in grill—perfect for entertaining under the coastal sky. Inside, the gourmet chef’s kitchen showcases premium Thermador appliances, double dishwashers, an expansive walk-in pantry, and elegant dining and living spaces enhanced by a whole-home Sonos sound system. An oversized first-floor king suite with its own fireplace and courtyard access adds a peaceful and refined touch. Thoughtfully designed across multiple levels and easily accessed by elevator, the home offers inviting spaces for both gathering and retreat. The second floor features two king suites, a spacious bunk room with twin-over-full bunks, and a media lounge ideal for movie nights, while the third floor hosts an additional king suite, lounge with wet bar, and a charming loft with four twin beds. At the very top, a spiral staircase leads to a breathtaking observation tower with 360-degree views of Rosemary Beach and the Gulf of Mexico—an unforgettable setting for sunset moments. Guests also enjoy access to private beach entry, six complimentary adult bikes for exploring scenic paths, and Rosemary Beach’s four community pools, creating an exceptional coastal escape filled with comfort, luxury, and adventure.

Features: Outdoor Outdoor grill Heated pool Pool
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
